thought.text: Image pulled successfully. Now I'll start the container in detached mode with data persistence, following the guide's production one-liner.

reasoning_content:
The image pull is complete. Next, I'll run the container in detached mode with the following settings:
- Port 8080:80
- SECRET_KEY_BASE
- OPENPROJECT_HOST__NAME=localhost:8080
- OPENPROJECT_HTTPS=false
- Volumes for pgdata and assets
- Name: openproject

After that, I'll wait for startup (the initial launch may take a few minutes) and check the logs for the admin password message.

action.command:
SKB=$(cat /workspace/openproject-install/secret_key_base.txt) && docker run -d -p 8080:80 --name openproject \
  -e OPENPROJECT_HOST__NAME=localhost:8080 \
  -e OPENPROJECT_HTTPS=false \
  -e OPENPROJECT_DEFAULT__LANGUAGE=en \
  -e SECRET_KEY_BASE="$SKB" \
  -v /var/lib/openproject/pgdata:/var/openproject/pgdata \
  -v /var/lib/openproject/assets:/var/openproject/assets \
  openproject/openproject:17

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "SKB=$(cat /workspace/openproject-install/secret_key_base.txt) && docker run -d -p 8080:80 --name openproject \\\n  -e OPENPROJECT_HOST__NAME=localhost:8080 \\\n  -e OPENPROJECT_HTTPS=false \\\n  -e OPENPROJECT_DEFAULT__LANGUAGE=en \\\n  -e SECRET_KEY_BASE=\"$SKB\" \\\n  -v /var/lib/openproject/pgdata:/var/openproject/pgdata \\\n  -v /var/lib/openproject/assets:/var/openproject/assets \\\n  openproject/openproject:17", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Start OpenProject container detached with data volumes"}
